summary.policy_type: Special Personal Health and Accident Insurance (Beyond Care Plan)
summary.insurer: Allianz Ayudhya General Insurance Public Company Limited
summary.policy_period: 12 Months (Annual Policy Term with Renewable Options)
summary.premium: Variable according to age, plan level, and chosen voluntary deductible tier (THB 15,000 - 45,000)
summary.limits_and_excess: THB 5,000,000 annual maximum benefit; Voluntary deductible options (THB 0 / 20,000 / 50,000)
main_coverages: Inpatient Hospitalization & Room Expense
Surgical and Medical Treatment Procedures
Personal Accident & Accidental Death Benefit
Emergency Medical Evacuation & Repatriation
Day Surgery & Emergency Outpatient Accident Care
major_exclusions: Pre-existing medical conditions not declared
War, Invasion, and Terrorism Acts
Intoxication with alcohol level exceeding 150 mg% or drug abuse
Self-inflicted injuries, suicide attempts, and hazardous sports
Cosmetic procedures, fertility treatments, and general health checkups

summary.target_insured: Corporate Employers, Employees, and Business Travellers
summary.premium: £8,450 estimated annual premium (Adjustable on declared wage roll and staff headcount)
summary.limits_and_excess: £2,000,000 Overseas Emergency Medical; £25,000 Personal Accident Capital; £50-£250 excess per travel claim
main_coverages: Personal Accident (Death, Loss of Limbs, Permanent Total Disablement)
Overseas Emergency Medical, Hospitalization & Repatriation
Business Travel Disruption (Cancellation, Delay, Missed Departure)
Baggage, Personal Effects & Business Equipment Loss
Kidnap, Ransom, and Crisis Containment Protection
major_exclusions: War and Nuclear Contamination Risks
Active service in Armed Forces
Pre-existing medical conditions unless declared and accepted
Suicide, intentional self-injury, and illegal activities
Travel undertaken against medical advice or for medical treatment

summary.policy_type: Complete Directors and Officers Liability Policy
summary.target_insured: Past, Present, and Future Directors, Officers, and Corporate Entity
summary.policy_period: 12 Months (Claims Made Basis with Extended Reporting Period Options)
summary.limits_and_excess: £5,000,000 aggregate policy limit; Nil excess for Individual D&O, £2,500-£10,000 for Corporate Reimbursement
main_coverages: Directors and Officers Liability (Side A Coverage)
Company Reimbursement Coverage (Side B Coverage)
Corporate Legal Liability (Side C Coverage)
Employment Practices Liability (EPL Protection)
Regulatory & Official Investigation Defence Costs
major_exclusions: Deliberate fraud, dishonesty, or willful violation established by final judgment
Prior pending litigation or claims notified prior to retroactive date
Bodily Injury and Property Damage liabilities
Environmental pollution and contamination claims (except defence costs extension)
Fines, penalties, or punitive damages where uninsurable by law

summary.target_insured: Cargo Owners, Shippers, Freight Forwarders, and Logistics Operators
summary.policy_period: 12 Months (Open Cover with Periodic Transit Declarations)
summary.premium: £18,200 adjustable based on annual declarations and sendings turnover
summary.limits_and_excess: £1,000,000 any one conveyance / vessel; £500-£1,000 standard deductible per transit loss
main_coverages: All Risks of physical loss or damage in transit (Institute Cargo Clauses A)
Fire, Explosion, Vessel Stranding, Grounding, or Sinking
Overturning or Derailment of Land Conveyance
Theft, Hijacking, and Piracy during transit
General Average and Salvage Contributions
major_exclusions: Loss caused by inherent vice or nature of the subject-matter
Insufficiency or unsuitability of packing or preparation
Ordinary leakage, ordinary wear and tear, or loss in weight
Insolvency or financial default of vessel owners or charterers
Nuclear weapon materials, radioactive contamination, and unseaworthiness

summary.premium: Determined by staff category, wage roll, turnover, and internal audit controls
summary.limits_and_excess: £250,000 any one loss / aggregate guarantee limit; Voluntary excess selectable
main_coverages: Direct financial loss caused by employee theft or fraud
Dishonesty of managers, salesmen, drivers, and accounts staff
Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) fraud and manipulation
Auditor & investigation expenses incurred to establish loss
major_exclusions: Unexplained inventory shortages or stock discrepancy
Losses occurring prior to retroactive date or undiscovered within limit
Employees with known prior dishonest records without underwriter consent
Consequential commercial loss, loss of profit, or indirect damages
